title: Why I started running
instructions: Ben koşmaya nasıl başladığını anlatıyor. Sebebe ve gelişmesine dikkat et.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Two years ago, I worked in an office all day and I never did any exercise.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: I felt tired all the time, so my doctor told me to start running.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: At first, I could only run for five minutes. It was terrible!

script.speaker: ben
script.text: But I ran three times a week, and slowly it got easier.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Last month, I ran my first half marathon. It took me two hours.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Now I feel much healthier, and I sleep better too.

options: He wanted to win a race.
